title: Better Forager's Leaves
description: Compatibility for Forager's Insight and Motchen's Better Leaves
body:
Little Resource Pack I made for compatibility between Motchen's Better Leaves and Forager's Insight. Works for Bountiful Oak, Dark Oak, and Spruce Leaves.

Credit to Tiomadre for the amazing [Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/foragers-insight) 
Credit to Better Leaves for the original resource pack [here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/better-leaves)
